title: Cosmic Serpent Lightning
description: A glowing purple and pink serpent with yellow crescent moon patterns coils in an infinity shape across a surreal landscape. Bright yellow lightning bolts strike from a vibrant explosion of colorful feathers, flowers, and bubbles in the upper left, where a woman's face emerges from the smoke.
prompt: A luminous purple serpent covered in yellow crescent moons coils into an infinity loop in a dreamy landscape. Bright yellow lightning strikes from a massive colorful explosion of vibrant pink, green, and yellow feathers, flowers, and bubbles in the sky. A woman's face emerges from the smoke and energy, with rolling hills, wooden fences, and distant ruins under a starry night sky.
